items.raw_excerpt: Rising global fuel prices could push tariffs higher next quarter, say SP Group and City Energy.
items.summary_en: SP Group and City Energy say household electricity and gas tariffs will be lower from October to December. The two companies add that rising fuel prices around the world could push tariffs back up next quarter.

items.title_en: Household electricity and gas tariffs drop from October to December

items.raw_excerpt: Lakapi Samoa is disappointed that the Oceania 7s rugby tournament has been cancelled.
items.summary_en: Lakapi Samoa says it is disappointed that the Oceania 7s rugby tournament has been cancelled. The event is a rugby sevens contest for teams from Pacific island countries, and Samoa was one of the sides taking part.

items.raw_excerpt: El combinado nacional cerrará su gira por Norteamérica en el Estadio Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum.
items.summary_en: Chile's national soccer team ends its North America trip in Los Angeles. The team plays Mexico in a friendly match at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. It is the last stop of the tour.

items.raw_excerpt: Sweden's state-owned train operator SJ is set to release its Christmas tickets at 9am today.
items.summary_en: Sweden's state-owned train operator SJ starts selling Christmas and New Year travel tickets at 9am. Tickets are expected to sell fast. Travelers can plan early trips by booking soon.

items.raw_excerpt: Jenny's Kindergarten and Early Learning Centre at Bathurst has been shut down due to non-compliance and child safety risks.
items.summary_en: A childcare centre in Bathurst, Australia, has been shut down by the government. Inspectors found 126 safety and rule breaches at the centre. The centre also faced risks to the safety of children in its care.

items.raw_excerpt: Fear of making a misstep can leave people unsure how to participate in reconciliation, but both Indigenous and non-Indigenous people say there are countless ways to contribute.
items.summary_en: Many people feel afraid of making a mistake, so they do not know how to join work on reconciliation between Indigenous and non-Indigenous people in Canada. But both sides say there are many ways to help.
items.summary_ko: 잘못한 일을 할까 봐 두려워서 많은 사람이 캐나다에서 원주민과 비원주민 사이의 화해를 위해 어떻게 참여해야 할지 모릅니다. 하지만 양쪽 모두 도와줄 수 있는 방법은 많다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Now That You Know the Truth, What Do You Do About Reconciliation?

items.raw_excerpt: María del Carmen Abascal's case has drawn tens of thousands of people to the streets in recent days and led the Spanish government to present measures to address the country's housing crisis.
items.summary_en: An 87-year-old woman was removed from her home in Spain. Tens of thousands of people took to the streets after it became known, and the government announced new plans for the housing crisis. She is now going back to her home.

items.summary_en: New road rules start in New Zealand on 1 October. They cover giving way, speed limits, and phone use in cars. Drivers and riders should read the changes before the rules begin.

items.raw_excerpt: After studying in a shared gymnasium, 70 preschool children in Ayun Commune in Gia Lai Province in central Vietnam now have two new classrooms.
items.summary_en: Seventy preschool children in Ayun Commune, Gia Lai Province now have two new classrooms. Until now, the children had to study together in a shared gymnasium. The new rooms are for Bahnar children, a small ethnic group in central Vietnam.

items.raw_excerpt: More people in the Netherlands are celebrating their birthday on Wednesday than on any other day of the year, with some 44,000 sharing September 30, according to national statistics office CBS. On average, 41,000 people in the Netherlands have a birthday every day. The number peaks in late September and early May. The figures are taken from over 15 million people who were born in the country and whose birth is officially registered with a local council. Those born abroad...
items.summary_en: About 44,000 people in the Netherlands have a birthday on September 30. That is more than on any other day of the year. The average is 41,000 birthdays a day, and the count peaks in late September and early May.
items.summary_ko: 9월 30일에 생일을 맞는 네덜란드인이 약 4만 4천 명에 이릅니다. 이는 일 년 중 어느 날보다도 많은 숫자입니다. 하루 평균 생일 수는 4만 1천 명이고, 9월 말과 5월 초에 가장 많습니다.
items.title_en: Wednesday Is the Busiest Birthday Day in the Netherlands
items.title_ko: 네덜란드에서 오늘이 일 년 중 가장 많은 생일

items.raw_excerpt: The Garvaghy Road Residents Coalition is seeking a meeting with PSNI Chief Constable Jon Boutcher as it continues its bid to stop a contentious Orange Order march at Drumcree.
items.summary_en: Residents near Drumcree want to meet the head of the police in Northern Ireland. They are trying to stop a yearly Orange Order march through their village. The police have not yet set a date for the meeting.

items.summary_en: Strong winds and rain left around 18,000 homes and businesses without power across Ireland on Wednesday morning. Many areas were still without electricity later in the day. Repair crews were working to restore the supply.

items.summary_en: A village football team won an FA Cup replay match. The game was ordered to be played again after the FA ruled that the referee made a mistake in the first match.

items.raw_excerpt: If you ever find yourself absolutely starving, this is a useful French word to know.
items.summary_en: The French word fringale comes from Italian and means a big feast. In France it also means a free early breakfast of bread and a drink at a bakery. The tradition is said to have started with bakers helping tired delivery drivers.
items.summary_ko: 프링갈(fringale)은 이태리어에서 온 프랑스어 단어로 원래 뜻은 큰 잔치입니다. 하지만 프랑스에서는 새벽에 빵집에 들러 빵과 음료를 공짜로 먹는 것을 가리킵니다. 지친 배달기사와 경찰에게 빵을 챙겨준 빵집 사장에서 시작된 이야기라고 합니다.
items.title_en: French Word of the Day: Fringale
items.title_ko: 프랑스어 오늘의 단어: 프링갈
items.title_original: French Word of the day: Fringale
